description: The reviewed ClaimCore component contract. Compiled architecture tests and the architecture document both read this file; neither restates it. Every .fsproj in the repository is classified here exactly once. Removing an edge, a package, or an internals grant requires no compatibility allowance.

components.name: ClaimCore.Domain
components.role: Accepted values, field metadata, validation, available transitions, and case state.

components.name: ClaimCore.RecordFormat
components.role: Byte-stable canonical command-record format 3, historical snapshots, and signed recovery-artifact format 3.

components.name: ClaimCore.Application
components.role: Actor-bound typed service facades, request admission, operation identity, endpoint outcomes and recovery decisions; internal scoped-core composition seams.

components.name: ClaimCore.Contracts
components.role: Pure semantic/CLI/Web schema projection, strict HTTP request codecs, wire rendering and generated browser DTOs; no host composition or storage effects.

components.name: ClaimCore.HostSecurity
components.role: Handle-first local private-file and directory admission. No claims or transport decision authority.

components.name: ClaimCore.Postgres
components.role: Durable actor-bound storage, exact fresh-schema admission, witnessed authority and recovery transactions, lifecycle and managed-copy evidence, and schema-owner administration.

components.name: ClaimCore.Witness
components.role: Independent PostgreSQL witness baseline and append-only authority journal; a separate service role can append through a narrow definer function and read back committed evidence.

components.name: ClaimCore.Hosting
components.role: The sole composition root. Owns actor-bound runtime opening, witness/key custody, data-source lifetime, and admission leases; the only component that binds stores to the core.

components.name: ClaimCore.CliProtocol
components.role: CLI framing, strict JSON decoding, discovery, and typed HTTPS/OIDC client seams. It cannot name a runtime factory or read a database credential.

components.name: ClaimCore.Cli
components.role: The CLI process entry point owns stdin/stdout delivery and fail-closed remote-service configuration; it never composes a database runtime.

components.name: ClaimCore.Web
components.role: HTTPS OIDC/OAuth admission, actor-bound Web transport, server-side browser sessions, and bearer service requests. Never reaches storage or schema administration.

components.name: ClaimCore.Database
components.role: Owner-private baseline, witness, backup and restore, copy custody, erasure, and activation administration. Never composes case work.

components.name: ClaimCore.Docs
components.role: Repository documentation: generated blocks, Markdown links and contract headings checked against the test inventories. Inspects the repository as data and never links product code.

components.name: ClaimCore.ContractGenerator
components.role: Materializes contract artifacts from the pure Contracts projection. Never a runtime authority.

components.name: ClaimCore.OidcQualification
components.role: Isolated live synthetic OIDC qualification harness for the Web authentication boundary.

components.name: ClaimCore.ArchitectureFixtures
components.role: Positive and negative F# shapes that qualify the compiled inspection mechanism itself.

components.name: ClaimCore.ArchitectureTests
components.role: Compiled enforcement of this manifest.

components.name: ClaimCore.Tests
components.role: Deterministic and property unit tests for the database-free boundaries.

components.name: ClaimCore.WebTests
components.role: Production-route TestServer, admission, and wire projection tests for the Web host.

components.name: ClaimCore.IntegrationTests
components.role: Isolated two-cluster PostgreSQL actor, transaction, lifecycle, witness, backup signer, audit, and fresh-baseline qualification.

components.name: ClaimCore.WitnessTests
components.role: Isolated live PostgreSQL 18.6 witness append, retry, durability, ACL, and corruption controls.

components.name: ClaimCore.BackupQualificationTests
components.role: Disposable two-cluster encrypted backup and restore qualification with recovered-data checks.

components.name: ClaimCore.RecoveryQualificationTests
components.role: Separate recovery qualification executable, so a generic integration pass cannot be reported as recovery evidence.

components.name: ClaimCore.ConcurrencyQualificationTests
components.role: Separate concurrency qualification executable.

components.name: ClaimCore.MigrationQualificationTests
components.role: Separate fresh-baseline creation/refusal qualification executable; stable historical evidence-producer identity.

components.name: ClaimCore.AcceptanceTests
components.role: Published-process acceptance against publish trees only; it links no product project.

components.name: ClaimCore.DocsTests
components.role: Tests for the repository documentation tooling.

components.name: ClaimCore.FuzzQualificationTests
components.role: Separate boundary-decoding qualification executable: every decoder that turns externally supplied bytes or tokens into typed values must refuse hostile input without throwing.
